output.summary: A unicellular green microalga found worldwide in freshwater and terrestrial habitats, it has spherical cells with a pea-green, cup-shaped chloroplast. Since the 1990s it has been considered a protein-rich food source and is now sold internationally as a dietary supplement or food additive.
output.edibilityNote: Since the 1990s, it has been used internationally as a dietary supplement or protein-rich food additive, including powders, tablets, capsules and extracts.
